en: Man
Past those falls, the road runs all the way to the Pokémon League. Only the strongest trainers make it there.
Megan
Ace Trainer Megan: Few trainers make it this far. Show me why you're one of them!
Ace Trainer Megan: I see. You really are on your way to the League.
Blake
Ace Trainer Blake: I came all this way to train by the sea. You'll do nicely!
Ace Trainer Blake: The waves are calmer than my head right now.
Jose
Bird Keeper Jose: My bird and I have flown over every cliff on this coast. Let's go!
Bird Keeper Jose: Grounded, just like that.
Brian
Ace Trainer Brian: One Pokémon, raised with everything I've got. That's all I need!
Ace Trainer Brian: Maybe I need a second one after all.
Eli
Psychic Eli: I saw this battle in a dream last night. I wonder how it ends...
Psychic Eli: My dream left out the ending. Now I know why.
Reena
Ace Trainer Reena: The sea breeze keeps my team sharp. Ready for a real battle?
Ace Trainer Reena: Sharp, but not sharp enough...

Tohjo Falls
The water falls where Johto's coast meets Kanto's.

Route 27
Tohjo Falls lies to the west, the road to the League to the east.
